title_zh: 继续记录温室香草的生长变化

scenario.label_zh: 安排温室香草的观察记录
scenario.goal_zh: 区分初步观察与确定结论，约定在同一时间拍摄并继续记录香草生长

context_zh: 社区花园的两名志愿者查看新种下的罗勒。
author: author-phase08-a

sentences.speaker: Mei
sentences.text: The basil in the greenhouse looks taller than it did last week.

sentences.speaker: Arthur
sentences.text: It's the first herb I've tried growing, so I keep checking it.

sentences.speaker: Mei
sentences.text: Our initial measurements are in this notebook. These plants were six centimetres tall.

sentences.speaker: Arthur
sentences.text: They seem to be growing gradually, rather than shooting up overnight.

sentences.speaker: Mei
sentences.text: Let's measure them again before we decide how much they've grown. The photo angle can be misleading.

sentences.speaker: Arthur
sentences.text: I'll take a picture from this same spot every Sunday morning.

sentences.speaker: Mei
sentences.text: And I'll write down the height beside each date. We can compare them next month.

targets.sense_zh: 供调味等用途的香草植物
